description: Process a holds a dbPessimistic dynaset on row 1, Edits and assigns N (no Update). Process b then tries, one at a time with errors recorded: an UPDATE statement on row 1, on row 2, on row 64, on row 1 of table U, an INSERT of row 200, and a dbPessimistic dynaset Edit/assign/Update on row 2 and on row 64. Process a then Updates and b reads rows 1, 2 and 64. Asks which of b's operations are refused or delayed while a's Edit is retained, and how a's Update ends.
